title: Establish and inspect retained engineering baselines
description: Establishes or retrieves an identifiable retained engineering state with its declared scope, authoritative content, interpretation basis, and provenance. It preserves the meaning of that state while later Changes evolve; it does not compare states or authorize adoption of a historical state.
inputs: Request to establish or inspect a Baseline within a selected governed project.
Declared scope and authoritative definitions, relationships, interpretation rules, provenance, and any included realization or assurance material.
preconditions: The selected project and applicable retention and coherence rules are identifiable.
outputs: Identified Baseline and its declared retained content and interpretation basis.
Explicit account of unresolved coherence, unavailable content, or external references outside retained content.
behavior: Associate the selected scope with an unambiguous Baseline identity and retain its authoritative content and provenance according to the applicable policy.
Check whether content and applicable rules establish the declared coherent state; expose omissions or conflicts instead of establishing an unsupported completeness claim.
Return the selected Baseline with its original definitions, relationship facts, rules, and provenance, even when current states have changed.
Distinguish actually retained material from external references, and preserve the included realization and assurance scope as declared.

failure_behavior.condition: Required content or interpretation rules are missing or conflicting.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the affected scope and withhold a claim that the selected collection is a complete coherent Baseline.

failure_behavior.condition: The requested retained state is unavailable.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report its unavailability without substituting the current state or another Baseline.

failure_behavior.condition: A requested retention action cannot be completed.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report what was retained and what remains unconfirmed; do not assert complete preservation.

unallocated_reason: Architectural responsibility is deliberately deferred until the logical requirements and system design are reconciled. This Function establishes behavior, not a Module, Interface, implementation, or verification result.

sources.basis: SR-020 confirms the logical behavior for identifiable coherent Baselines and preserved historical content under IR-003.
